title: Build a Counter
prompt:
Build a simple counter widget that:

- Shows the current count starting at 0
- Has a + button that increments the count
- Has a - button that decrements the count
- Has a Reset button that sets the count back to 0
- Prevents the count from going below 0

**Preview:** the right-hand preview shows `index.html` from this project (static server — no bundler). Put the app in `index.html` (+ `style.css` / `main.js` or CDN). Vanilla JS or CDN only — no Vite/npm.

You're done when + / − / Reset work correctly in Preview.
